title: [Mai][German Localization] Recurring Frequency DateFormula Exports as Invariant Tokens (+1D/+1Y) Instead of Localized UI Tokens (+1T/+1J) in ExcelInital commit
summary: The Recurring General Journal page now exports recurring frequency date formulas in localized UI tokens (like +1T for German) instead of invariant tokens (+1D) when exporting to Excel or OData.
key_points: Recurring Frequency on page 283 is now bound to a text variable holding Format() of the DateFormula, so exports use session-language tokens
Entered text is converted back with Evaluate and stored as the DateFormula on validation
Fixes German exports showing +1D/+1Y instead of +1T/+1J in Excel
Page changed in the W1, APAC, ES, IT and RU layers
Unit tests added in ERMGeneralJournalUT across several country layers
quote: Recurring Frequency DateFormula Exports as Invariant Tokens (+1D/+1Y) Instead of Localized UI Tokens (+1T/+1J) in Excel
